title: Prefill: sparse MLA + prologue
shape: DEP16 F16K (3 x 5,461 tok) at L78K, NVFP4, 96 heads/GPU, top-2048, FP8 KV 576 B rows; 24 DSA layers
basis: MEASURED in-step at F8K x2 (perf-model/microbench/results/prefill rows.json P3-16 pf8k_L78k: sparse_mla 25.43 ms incl. index_remap 0.69, prologue+aux 6.55, gate_mul 1.69 per step); model ach from out/optables.json 'nvfp4_modelopt|P3-16|prefill' (DSA.sparse_mla 643.1 us + DSA.prologue 10.9 us + DSA.gate_mul 7.7 us per layer x 24)
gap_analysis: Per F8K step (in-step, release tree): trtllm-gen decode-form fmhaSm107a (QkvE4m3 HQk576 HV512 HVPerCta256 SparseP1 Q64Kv128 2Cta) 24.74 ms = 3.2x its model share; standalone at F16K (ops1 sparse_mla-161) 2480 us/layer vs 643 us model ach. Prologue 6.55 ms (scaled_fp8_quant 2.60, _pad_query_heads 2.06, concat_and_cache_mla 0.84, plus ~1 ms unidentified), gate_mul 1.69 ms. Code reading (this tree): at TP1/DCP1 the in-place RoPE concat path leaves q_pe empty, so quantize_decode_query (the fused quant+pad Triton kernel) is skipped and quant + pad run as two passes over a 1.1 GB/1.5 GB query; trtllm-gen writes a 128-head BF16 output that w_uv reads through a strided [:, :96] view. Kernel-level root cause of the 3.2x is not yet measured (ncu run1 queued).
inefficiencies: Decode-form trtllm-gen kernel used for prefill: one token per request, 2048 KV rows gathered per token (MEASURED in-step time; per-cause split pending ncu)
96 -> 128 head padding: 25% of MMA work wasted plus a padded query copy and 128-head output (MEASURED kernel names; cost share pending ncu)
HVPerCta256: V512 split across CTAs may recompute QK per V half (HYPOTHESIS, ncu pending)

Query quant and head pad are two separate full passes (scaled_fp8_quant + _pad_query_heads) because the in-place RoPE concat disables the fused quant_pad kernel (code reading, MEASURED 4.66 ms/F8K step)
gate_mul is a separate pass over the [T, 12288] BF16 output (MEASURED 1.69 ms/F8K step)
Unidentified ~1 ms kernel in the DSA prologue (to identify in a profile)
rubin_features: tcgen05 FP8 (kind::f8f6f4) MMA with TMEM accumulators, 2-CTA pairs
extended TMEM column budget on sm_107 (fits S and the full 512-wide O for a 96-head tile)
TMA gather4 / async bulk copies for paged KV row gather
redux.sync f32 max for cross-lane softmax reductions (transposed-tile design option)
PDL (programmatic dependent launch) between prologue, attention and w_uv
plan: 1. Measure the stock chain kernel by kernel at F8K/F16K on 1 GPU (bench in branch) and ncu the trtllm-gen kernel: tensor pipe %, DRAM/L2 bytes, QK recompute check
2. Bench FlashInfer prims_ts sparse MLA at 96/128 heads as an existing alternative (per-shape dispatch candidate)
3. Quick prologue win: one fused kernel for RoPE-concat + FP8 quant + (if still needed) head pad; fuse gate_mul into the w_uv bmm epilogue (bitwise vs stock)
4. New prefill-form CuTe DSL sparse MLA (sm_107): native 96 heads, single QK per KV tile feeding the full 512-wide O in TMEM, double-buffered paged-KV gather, FP8 KV as stored
5. Unit tests vs stock (tolerance of the stock FP8-P kernel), microbench at F8K/F16K vs model, then step A/B on the INFRA 1-node harness
